faq.question: Where is Mesudarot located?
faq.answer: Mesudarot is located at 50 Dizengoff, inside Dizengoff Center Tel Aviv. The site includes a direct Waze link for easy navigation.

faq.question: How do I book an appointment at Mesudarot?
faq.answer: You can make an appointment online through the click appointment button, call 03-620-9661 or send us a WhatsApp message.

faq.question: What treatments are available at Mesudarot?
faq.answer: In the institute you will find manicures, gel polish, pedicures, facial treatments, hair removal, laser, eyebrow shaping and beauty treatments for women and men.

faq.question: What are the opening hours?
faq.answer: Opening hours are Sunday to Thursday 09:00-21:00, Friday 08:00-15:00, Saturday closed.
